Setup.Name: Automatically parse Json
Setup.Description: A simple example on how to parse a json automatically.
Setup.Manifest:
Processors:
  - Name: "Processor Temperature"
    Description: "Provides the current processor temperature."
    Mqtt: 
      Subscriptions:
        - Name: "Processor information"
          Topic: "message-topic"
    Otel:
      Metrics:
        - Instrument: Gauge
          ParseAs: 
             Type: Json
             Separator: "_"
